name: Queen Eira
title: The Silver Line
examine: Ford-born and mountain-crowned. She watches a room the way a ferryman watches the water — pleasantly, and missing nothing.
lines: I grew up at the ford, counting toll wagons. I married up the mountain and now I count everything else.
At midday I walk to the mere and let the city forget I'm a queen for an hour. It never quite manages. Neither do I.
Halvard signs the charters. I read them first. That is the whole secret of the Silver Line, and you may keep it.
